role: Shared test fixtures: deterministic RR point generators (sine-varying and uniform), clean artifact flags, XCTestCase.pinEnglishLanguage (English for one test, restored in teardown) and requireEncryptionKey (fails the test when the app's key is out of reach), HostDefaults (sets the host's own standard-defaults keys aside for a test and puts them back) with the recording-state and sync-bookkeeping key lists, and CloudKitSyncManager.isolated (a sync manager of the test's own).
types: XCTestCase: extension — adds pinEnglishLanguage() and requireEncryptionKey(file:line:)
HostDefaults: struct — a set of standard-defaults keys and the host's values of them, set aside and restored
state: mem:HostDefaults.cloudSyncBookkeeping (the sync keys resetLocalSyncState and boot clear in standard defaults)
toplevel: Three free functions, two XCTestCase helpers, the HostDefaults struct with two static key lists, and one CloudKitSyncManager factory; no stored state beyond the key lists.

units.does: Builds count RRPoints with rr = max(300, meanRR + Int(sin(i/50)*40)) and cumulative t_ms from startMs.

branches.effect: appends one point per index; count 0 returns []

units.does: Builds count RRPoints with a fixed rr and t_ms = i*rr.
If the app locale is not already English, saves AppLanguage.current, calls LanguageManager.shared.setLanguage(.en) and registers a teardown block restoring the saved language.

branches.effect: returns without changing anything; otherwise switches to English and schedules restore

units.does: Fails the calling test at the caller's line and throws (XCTUnwrap of nil) when EncryptionManager.shared.isAvailable is false; returns when the key can be read or made. A failure, not a skip, so a key-dependent assertion can never pass silently.

branches.effect: XCTUnwrap fails the test and throws; else returns

units.does: For each key, keeps the host's value from UserDefaults.standard (when there is one) and removes the key; returns a HostDefaults holding the keys and the kept values.

branches.cond: the host has a value for the key

units.does: For each key set aside, writes the host's kept value back to UserDefaults.standard, or removes the key when the host had none (so whatever a test left is dropped).

branches.cond: a value was kept for the key
branches.effect: written back; else the key is removed

units.does: Builds a CloudKitSyncManager over `archive` with the given settings (else a fresh-install SettingsManager on directory/user_settings.json) and its bookkeeping at directory/sync_state.json, boots it (loads the empty state) and returns it. Nothing it records reaches CloudKitSyncManager.shared; what it keeps in standard defaults is HostDefaults.cloudSyncBookkeeping.

branches.effect: used; else a fresh SettingsManager in directory
